root_causes.text: Lane routes were built as code, but relay lifetime was never supervised. Autostart disabled + no service + manual start = every reboot silently degrades to 'one model alive'.
Probed the desktop router (10102) as if it were the lane relay (10101/10100). This is the exact session-plane vs lane-plane confusion the owner instruction warns about.
Read the assignment table, not the measured chain; skipped the preflight that exists for exactly this purpose; treated one red receipt as a capability verdict.

config/model-lane-assignment.json states four different lane assignments (assignment rows / lane_chains / declared_by / user_instruction_revision_2). --require-assigned-arms therefore selected the dead arm instead of the live chain primary.

prior_round_gaps.text: Transport supervision never built (RC-1) - the 2026-10-11 success was a live process, not a durable capability.
Owner-gated items logged but never closed: binary pin refresh, NVIDIA provider activation on relay, gpt-6-luna live admission (manual 28). These are exactly today's F-06 and the missing fallbacks.
Every round closed at T1 and deferred T2/T3; no round was ever chartered to build an acceptor, so native stays 0/22 by construction, not by bad luck.
Six PRs opened, none merged: main is not the source of truth, so each new round re-inherits the same gaps.
